about.title: Mohammed Al Faraj
about.subtitle: GACA-Certified Commercial Drone Pilot
about.description: Based in the heart of Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, Mohammed Al Faraj is a leading provider of professional drone photography and videography services. With extensive operational experience and full GACA commercial authorization, we deliver high-quality aerial imaging solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, compliance, and creativity.
about.mission: Our work blends technical precision with cinematic vision, enabling us to support major industries including energy, construction, infrastructure, logistics, defense, and media production.
about.imageAlt: Professional Drone Photography by Mohammed Al Faraj

features.title: Professional Equipment & Expertise
features.subtitle: Cutting-Edge Technology Meets Creative Vision
features.description: We use cutting-edge drone technology and professional camera systems to deliver stunning aerial imagery that exceeds industry standards. Every project benefits from our advanced equipment and years of experience.
features.commitment: Our commitment to excellence means investing in the latest technology and maintaining the highest operational standards to ensure your project receives the quality it deserves.
